en: Sepia-toned photograph of a large Romanesque-style church with two very tall, slender square towers topped by steep spires flanking the façade. The central front has a large rose window and rounded arches, with a smaller entrance arcade and a forecourt with gates and low walls. Behind the façade rises a massive octagonal crossing tower. Trees partly frame the building, and a few small human figures stand near the entrance. No printed text is visible on the image side.
